title: Emit a phase-correct coded p16 caller removing 144 center calls (no κ)
body:
The center-free producer in #4929 deletes eight recursive center calls per FULL but changes the main outputs by an owner-mixing code. This package supplies a phase-correct common-query interface and emits the entire exact rational p16 caller using that interface. Across 18 FULLs it removes **144 rank-eight recursive calls**, retaining all 15 paid IDLEs and 15 thin queries.

The 3,584 arbitrary main inputs and 7,344 independent helper inputs remain independent. The 16 negative-query banks end at `Q^-1 B_i D_i`; the 16 positive-query banks end at `B_i D_i Q`. Every ordered code product `B_i` is emitted. Positive-bank postdecoding is priced. **The negative banks remain coded outputs: this is not yet a Gaussian supplier, a profitable complete multiplication algorithm, or a new κ.**

## What is new

- 112 phase-correct normalizers and 896 literal monomial wrappers, preserving the full Gaussian including absolute phase. The backward convention requires X-only `Q^2` conjugation; the old Y-only convention fails.
- A costed eight-mode owner recoding and complete rational caller recipe. The caller uses 194 code evaluations: 173,824 scalar ADDs, 43,456 monomial field maps, 3,104 CLEARs and eight reusable temporary fields. Optional positive-half postdecoding costs 97 additional evaluations. Inverse recoding has coefficient `-1/52`; fixed-denominator implementation and precision remain obligations.
- A scoped terminal obstruction: each of the 5,824 nonzero blocks of one `Q^-1 C Q` has `4^f` row support. A fixed finite monomial/scalar word cannot silently erase that one-stage code uniformly in width. This does not exclude cancellation across stages, a paid decoder or another caller.

The all-width arguments, exact emitted recipe, source manifest, independent finite check and open next questions are in `research/coded-native-caller/`. The noncommuting controller core is inherited, with an independent source-bound replay; it is not claimed as a new theorem.

## Evidence

At submission head `d969c458c24278e0fd37e5b4c0ff8a53a496b430`:

- Registered Python 3.12.15 replay passed; isolated optimized Python 3.14.7 replay passed.
- Exact phase/tableau, wrapper, eight-mode factorization, symbolic transport, all 1,024 noncommuting-controller core entries and emitted boundary checks passed.
- Separate-agent modular propagation over F_65537 checks two deterministic vectors on 112 owners × 512 addresses and rejects the obsolete backward correction. Sampling corroborates the written universal argument; it does not replace it.
- Fresh pinned #4929 replay passed for all 632 arbitrary source rows in both orientations, 28,045 events each. This is predecessor evidence, not a new producer result.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight, whitespace checks, official 26-file export and export integrity passed. The exported package passed under Python 3.12 with `-I -O -B`, network denied and no Git on PATH.
- Selected baseline source bindings passed. No selected cold replay, Lean/kernel verification or full multiplication implementation was run. Hosted CI passed: both the onboarding/selection job and the registered package replay, including the committed-input check ([run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39889328977)).

Reproduce from repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/coded-native-caller
python3.12 -I -O -B research/coded-native-caller/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/coded-native-caller --check-source-history
```

## Scope, overlap and next theorem

[Canonical investigation #4930](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4930). This approximately one-hour session spent more than five minutes comparing high-impact avenues and reserved its final quarter for verification. Scientific inputs remain frozen at canonical `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43` and #4929 head `361f5d4100640177d6a983dd2f336021c75bfd5e`. Refreshed canonical `cef4b52f2a59009865bf8eabde1be3f159063703` is merged into the branch; priorities and selected κ=0.00302015 remain unchanged. Only this new research package differs from main.

The final full overlap refresh covered 303 open PRs and 4,003 Discussions with complete remote pagination; sparse local-note coverage was incomplete and is recorded in TASK.json. A later live check read #4931 at `90a0124d306ef8802ac2dc3601c6705dca407e45`: its one-port physical-prefix offer is distinct from this full coded-producer caller. These checks do not establish universal novelty.

The next decisive question is whether the negative coded jobs admit a recursive interface or affordable decoder. A chronological child substitution must survive the next scalar/warp contact, preserve independent ownership, and pay every query. Fixed-denominator recoding, precision, routing/tape, complete compiler closure and outer recovery remain open. The unchanged-target planning estimate near 0.00765 is motivation only and is not an admissible bound.
